Retain the original complete A plan and its original absolute deadline, then construct a fresh closure, intent, proposal and real Raft Stage/Publish at the current B predecessor. Keep all 30 assertions, the original B step, all warm/cold/reopen checks and the original 60 tests unchanged.

Only the test module changes. Pinned rustfmt passed on ROG; Rust compilation and the successor 61-test runs remain pending. The prior Mac run remains 60 pass plus one failed regression, with no qualification transfer.
